hook.say: Five questions about the world's mountains. They get steeper as you go. Can you reach the summit?

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Mount Everest is part of which mountain range?
questions.fact: Everest stands 8,849 meters high, on the border of Nepal and China.
questions.sayAnswer: The Himalayas! Everest stands 8,849 meters high, on the border of Nepal and China.

questions.q: Which is the longest mountain range on land?
questions.fact: The Andes run the whole length of South America, through 7 countries.
questions.sayAnswer: The Andes! They run the whole length of South America, through 7 countries.

questions.q: Which mountain range traditionally divides Europe from Asia?
questions.fact: The Urals stretch about 2,500 km from north to south across Russia.
questions.sayAnswer: The Urals! They stretch about 2,500 kilometers from north to south across Russia.

questions.q: What is the second-highest mountain on Earth?
questions.fact: K2 is 8,611 meters high. It was the 2nd peak surveyed in the Karakoram.
questions.sayAnswer: K2! It is 8,611 meters high. The name means it was the 2nd peak surveyed in the Karakoram range.

questions.q: Measured from base to summit, which is the tallest mountain on Earth?
questions.fact: Mauna Kea in Hawaii rises about 10,200 meters from the ocean floor.
questions.sayAnswer: Mow-na Kay-ah! This Hawaiian volcano rises about 10,200 meters from the ocean floor. Most of it is under water.
